programme.title: Great Destinations Americas
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.desc: Before crossing the Alps and visiting the Ambras castle, the Imperial Palace, the cathedral and the Tyrolean State Museum, it is important to understand the origins of Tyrol. Beginning in the XII century, in the mountains of Alto Adige. We travel along the Inn and the Adige rivers to the entrance of the Vinschgau Valley, before visiting Tyrol Castle, and the city of Merano.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Jeff looks back on the most unforgettable food and travel moments from his journey across Guatemala. From the playful energy of a monkey sanctuary in the Petén region to the vibrant streets of Antigua, this episode is a celebration of the people, places, and flavors that defined the experience. The journey concludes with a special meal prepared by acclaimed chef Mario Campollo at the stunning Casa Santo Domingo Spa & Resort—a fitting finale to a season filled with culture, connection, and culinary wonder.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We discover Franklin, TN also known to its locals for being voted as best small town in TN. Adventure starts our day, with a thrilling and beautiful ride showcasing the town views in a hot air balloon ride. From there we explore the history of downtown Franklin and end the day with some amazing southern cuisine.
